observation.visible_scene: A night scene over a calm body of water with a low, lit city skyline on the horizon. A volley of firework bursts occupies the upper-middle sky: one large spherical burst on the right, a horizontal row of four to five smaller spherical bursts to its left, a couple of tiny points above the row, and a small low burst near the horizon on the right. The water mirrors the bright bursts and the skyline lights.
visible_changes: The large right-hand burst is already expanded at the first frame and persists in roughly the same position, gradually shifting hue from greenish-white to pink/red and back toward pale green/white as its dots fade.

The row of gold bursts stays in place and slowly broadens; the tiny red points above the row grow into several new pink/red spherical bursts that expand in their own positions rather than translating.
Overall the spheres brighten and mix colors (gold, pink, green, white) through the middle of the clip, then transition into more separated, twinkling dots that dim toward the end.
From roughly the middle of the clip onward, thin near-vertical streaks appear and lengthen beneath several bursts, becoming more distinct as the spherical dots fade.

The reflections on the water track these changes: the right reflection mirrors the large burst's color shift, and the row's reflections grow and dim in sync; small ripple-driven jitter is visible in the mirrored shapes.

The skyline, horizon line, and overall framing remain fixed, indicating the camera is essentially static (only minor handheld-level jitter), so the apparent motion is the fireworks themselves expanding and changing color, not camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: The moment of launch and initial explosion for each burst (the display is already mid-burst at the first frame).
Whether the vertical streaks are falling ember trails, shell ascent trails, or artifacts of fading sparks.
The final dissipation of the bursts and any subsequent volleys after the last frame.
uncertain_details: Exact timing of color transitions between individual bursts.
Whether the slight frame-to-frame positional wobble of the bursts is handheld camera jitter or water/air distortion.
The precise cause and nature of the vertical streaks beneath the bursts.
